# Quick Reference: Using GitHub Copilot Skills

## Chat Commands by Workflow

### 👋 Onboarding
\\\
@copilot #acquire-codebase-knowledge
Explain the project structure and main folders
\\\

### 🏗️ Architecture Review
\\\
@copilot #architecture-blueprint-generator
Create a visual diagram of the React component hierarchy
\\\

### 🚀 Feature Development
\\\
@copilot #react18-batching-patterns
Show me how to use React 18 batching for this component
\\\

### ✅ Testing
\\\
@copilot #javascript-typescript-jest
Generate a comprehensive test suite for this module

@copilot #playwright-generate-test
Create E2E tests for the Quiz flow
\\\

### 🔒 Security
\\\
@copilot #security-review
Audit this code for security vulnerabilities
\\\

### 🔧 Refactoring
\\\
@copilot #refactor
Suggest improvements for this function
\\\

### 📚 Documentation
\\\
@copilot #documentation-writer
Generate API documentation for the storage service

@copilot #context-map
Create a module dependency map
\\\

### 🎯 Quality Standards
\\\
@copilot #quality-playbook
What are the code quality standards for this project?
\\\

## Integrated Workflow Examples

### Complete Feature Development
1. Ask \#acquire-codebase-knowledge\ how similar features are implemented
2. Use \#react18-batching-patterns\ for performance considerations
3. Ask \#javascript-typescript-jest\ to generate tests
4. Request \#playwright-generate-test\ for E2E coverage
5. Run \#security-review\ before submission
6. Use \#quality-playbook\ to verify standards

### Refactoring Session
1. Use \#architecture-blueprint-generator\ to visualize current structure
2. Use \#context-map\ to understand dependencies
3. Ask \#refactor\ for improvement suggestions
4. Generate tests with \#javascript-typescript-jest\
5. Validate with \#security-review\

### Documentation Sprint
1. Use \#code-tour\ to understand features
2. Use \#architecture-blueprint-generator\ for diagrams
3. Use \#documentation-writer\ for content
4. Use \#context-map\ for dependency documentation
